title: skills/sprint, item and backlog and agents/worker.md exist at the plugin root, parameterised by ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, and plugin.json lists them
goal: skills/sprint, skills/item and skills/backlog at the plugin root and agents/worker.md are the kb's kb-sprint, kb-item, kb-backlog and kb-worker with every backlog.py command run as python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_tools/backlog.py and no kb-only path in their text; a skill's name is its directory's, so a link under another name serves it; .claude-plugin/plugin.json lists them; the worker role file is read from the plugin when the project has none; plugin.json and kb/_self/plugin.md say what the plugin now ships.
